messages.subject: ezAVNOA versus Anova
messages.body_plain:
Hi Mike,

Thanks for all your work on this awesome package.

I have a concern when running a 2x2 between ANOVA in ezANOVA versus Anova (car). Specifying type 2 versus 3 in Anova givens different results, but specifying type in ezANOVA always returns type 2. Any guidance on why this is the case?

Take care.

Tyler
